turns.user: why does my plan put protein in every single meal? can't I just have a big steak at dinner and be done
turns.reply:
Your body can only use about 30 to 40 grams of protein for muscle building at one time. 



Spacing it out triggers muscle building multiple times a day instead of just once. 



Since full meals take effort, shifting to three solid meals with around 40g in each is your best option, but we can tweak it other ways too. How does your current meal setup feel to manage?
